g.text: Sequence Diagram - BCK05 Update Product incl. Stock-Control Changes (PUT /api/v1/products/:id)
{ full editable state, incl. isStockControlled, initialUnits? }
[invalid id / field value / invariant (checked BEFORE any DB access)]
SELECT ... FROM products WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
[changing referenced component type or incompatible pricing mode]
throw AppError(409, "Existing configuration would be invalid")
initialUnits is optional; BCK09 defaults it to 0.
It is used only on the false -> true transition.
BCK09 preserves the final availableUnits as a historical snapshot.
No zero-quantity precondition; no DELETE or movement ledger.
No call to BCK09: stock record and
quantity are left untouched, even if initialUnits
was supplied with an ordinary Product update.
Product flag and current/historical stock records are
restored together; a failed step never
isActive is NOT changed by this flow, and BCK05 never changes stock quantities.
A stock decrease to 0 performed through BCK09 does not call BCK05: the product
stays active and stock-controlled, just without available stock.
Client permits disabling tracking with any non-negative quantity; history is retained.
Re-enabling starts a new current snapshot with optional initialUnits (default 0).
